account.title: Speaker account
account.description:
1. Open [the VK login]({login_url}) in a browser and log in with the VK account the speaker is linked to.
2. The login ends on a blank page `oauth.vk.com/blank.html` or `oauth.vk.ru/blank.html`. Copy the whole address from the address bar and paste it below.

The address holds a VK token, valid for a short time: paste it right away.

cabinet.title: DIY cabinet session
cabinet.description: Log in to {cabinet_url} in a browser. Open DevTools → Application → Cookies → vc.go.mail.ru and copy the value of the `sh_data` cookie (a whole `Cookie` header also works). One session serves all speaker accounts and lives about 13 months.

reauth_account.title: Log in to VK again: {name}
reauth_account.description: The Marusya session of «{name}» has expired. Open [the VK login]({login_url}) with the same VK account and paste the address of the blank page.

reauth_cabinet.title: DIY cabinet session expired
reauth_cabinet.description: Log in to {cabinet_url} again and paste the new value of the `sh_data` cookie.

error.not_blank_page: This is not the page the VK login ends on: expected oauth.vk.com/blank.html or oauth.vk.ru/blank.html.
error.vk_refused: VK refused the login: the address carries an error instead of a token. Start the login again.
error.payload_unreadable: The VK ID answer in the address cannot be read. Copy the address again, entirely.
error.no_token: The address has no token: copy it after the login has finished.
error.marusya_refused: The Marusya server did not accept the VK token. The token may be expired (a VK ID token lives 10 minutes): log in again.
error.wrong_account: This is another VK account: log in with the account of this speaker.
error.cabinet_refused: The DIY cabinet does not open with this cookie: it is expired or copied partially.
error.cannot_connect: vc.go.mail.ru does not answer. Check the network of Home Assistant and try again.

abort.already_configured: This VK account or the cabinet session is already added.

init.title: Devices
init.description: Devices the speakers of this account see: entities with the label, entities picked from the list and the YAML list, all together. Name is the entity name, type follows its domain, room is its area or the default room. YAML describes a device precisely and wins over the same picked entity; format — {format_url}

error.not_a_list: Expected a YAML list of devices.
error.bad_entity_id: Device {where}: entity_id must look like domain.object_id.
error.bad_type: Device {where}: unknown type; allowed types are listed in the format description.
error.no_room: Device {where} has no room and there is no default room.
error.bad_service: Device {where}: service must look like domain/service.
error.bad_id: Device {where}: id may contain only letters, digits, _ and -.
error.unknown_entities: No such entities in Home Assistant: {where}.
